provenance.operation: Continue the identical fine-grid physical model, objective, target, bounds, initial state and tightened 0.001 Nm torque tolerance. On damping-limit stalls, automatically shrink the derivative probe by 10 to a 1e-9 floor and reset damping, within the original total iteration/evaluation budgets. The measured 1e-7 gradient pointed uphill; the 1e-9 gradient agrees with independent directional differences. No gait timings prescribed and no acceptance relaxed.
provenance.limitations: This improves local numerical search, not a full IDTO equality-constrained dogleg solver or MPC. Runtime, timestep, sustained gait, collision/slip and WASD validation remain separate.
